findings.summary: The premise of the stored-detail change is false: a passing attempt's criteria check is already stored and already shown in the introspection event
findings.evidence: `Candidate.producer_report: Option<ProducerReport>` (crates/athena-data/src/records.rs:863) holds the redacted report, including `criteria_check` (records.rs:821). It is set from the report that leaves the loop (candidate.rs:64-83 via candidate_stage) and committed as a Candidate2 record (close.rs:630-631). introspect.rs:1023-1056 `pre_verdict_block` adds "Producer's own check of each unmet criterion, before the verdict" to the event, from that record (introspect.rs:1607-1610). It was added in HISTORY.txt:53, commit 81b1374e, "Show the producer's pre-verdict criteria check in introspection events". Failing attempts already keep their report in `detail` (producer.rs:621). So every attempt's report is already stored somewhere. The plan says the passing attempt 'kept no record of the criteria check' and that its change is what lets 'an introspection reader see the criterion checked before the verdict'. Both claims are wrong, and criterion 1 asks the change description to name the root cause accurately. Fix: Cite candidate.producer_report and pre_verdict_block (81b1374e) in the plan, in the D191 Case and in the CHANGELOG. Name the root cause as only the brief gap. Present the passing-attempt detail as a per-attempt copy that keeps each invocation record self-contained, not as new information, and state that it duplicates the candidate's report. Alternatively, put an Open question to the user saying criterion 4 is met in substance by the candidate record, and ask whether the duplicate should still ship. Add `Candidate.producer_report` and introspect.rs `pre_verdict_block` to the dependents, with the existing introspect tests (introspect.rs:2881-3010) as their coverage.
findings.location: Plan Approach (2), Decision 2, Step 3 (the root-cause comment), Step 5 (D191) and the CHANGELOG entry; crates/athena-core/src/run/producer.rs:555

findings.summary: The behavior hint contradicts the brief's LEFT_TO_ATHENA rule for fmt, clippy and full-test criteria, and the reason given for not reusing the classifier is wrong
findings.evidence: For each behavior criterion the hint says 'cite the exact command and what it printed; the verifier runs it itself'. criteria_check_section (briefs.rs:857-861) tells the producer to mark fmt, clippy and full cargo test criteria with "left to Athena's checks", and says the verifier judges them from the recorded checks. Nearly every reading has such a criterion, this one included (criterion 5), so the brief would give two conflicting instructions for the same line. Decision 4 says send_back.rs cannot be reused because of crate reach. But athena-core depends on athena-context, so `is_athena_check_criterion` (send_back.rs:67-89, a pure string function) can move down into athena-context and core can import it from there. Fix: Move `is_athena_check_criterion` into athena-context (briefs.rs, next to LEFT_TO_ATHENA) and call it from send_back.rs. For a criterion it matches, use a hint pointing to Athena's recorded checks and the LEFT_TO_ATHENA marker. Assert this hint in the new brief test.
findings.location: Plan Step 1 (Behavior hint text) and Decision 4 (rejected reuse of is_athena_check_criterion)

findings.summary: The 'wrap' substring matcher fires on 'wrapper' and similar words
findings.evidence: A lowercase substring match on 'wrap' fires on 'wrapper', which is common in this repository (for example "installing the producer's cargo wrapper", producer.rs:382). Such a criterion would get a needless line-width hint. The Risks section names over-matching but only tests a plain criterion, not a near miss. Fix: Match whole words or phrases ('rewrap', 'rewrapped', 'line width', 'wrapped prose'). Add a unit case where a criterion mentioning 'wrapper' gets no width hint.
findings.location: Plan Decision 4 and Step 1 (wrap phrase list)

summary: Read in the snapshot: briefs.rs, producer.rs, send_back.rs, candidate.rs, records.rs, introspect.rs, the related tests and HISTORY.txt. The brief half of the plan is sound. `producer_brief_with_evidence` (briefs.rs:682-753) has `checkable_evidence_section` at line 743 and `criteria_check_section` at line 744, as the plan says. `AcceptedReading.criteria` is a pub `Vec<(String, CriterionKind)>` (briefs.rs:80). Criteria are numbered at briefs.rs:322-323. The test fixtures (`reading()`, `defaults()`, `run_checked_job`, `marked_check`, `editing`) exist. Demonstrations 3 and 4 would fail on the base tree. The second half of the plan rests on a false premise. A passing attempt's redacted report, with its per-criterion status and evidence, is already stored in the candidate record: `Candidate.producer_report` (records.rs:863), set at candidate.rs:83 and written at close.rs:631. Commit 81b1374e (2026-11-15) already shows it in the stored introspection event through `pre_verdict_block` (introspect.rs:1024, read at introspect.rs:1610). So the stored-detail change copies data that is already kept, and the D191 and CHANGELOG text the plan describes would name a gap that does not exist. That conflicts with criterion 1. Smaller problems: the behavior hint contradicts the LEFT_TO_ATHENA rule for fmt, clippy and test criteria, and the 'wrap' matcher over-matches.
